evidence.quote: Conjecture 1.16 (Jia[25]) g(n) = n + log2 n + O(1), as n → ∞.

accepted.question_text: For the Turán number ex(n, C₂k), defined as the maximum number of edges in an n-vertex graph that contains no cycle of length 2k as a subgraph, does there exist a positive constant c such that ex(n, C₂k) ≥ c n^(1+1/k)?

evidence.quote: for every simple eulerian graph G.

accepted.question_text: Let G be a simple connected graph on n vertices. Can the edge set of G always be decomposed into at most (n + 1)/2 paths?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3.12 (Gallai’s conjecture) Every simple connected graph on n vertices can be decomposed into at most (n + 1)/2 paths.
